e.title: Medical Insurance DApp (Ethereum)
e.summary: 以太坊医疗险理赔 DApp（126★，ConsenSys，2026-09 活跃）：病人上传账单→医院/实验室链上审批→保险理赔
e.body: HealthCare-Insurance-Ethereum（Rishabh42，126★，Solidity，2026-09-03 更新）是医疗险理赔去中心化应用（ConsenSys 项目）：病人登录上传医疗/检验账单提交理赔——医院管理员在智能合约上验证批准、实验室管理员批准检验账单、双方批准后保险管理员计算并执行理赔；HealthCare.sol 合约维护逻辑，Web 客户端与合约交互。对 RIAA：区块链医疗理赔的可运行教学 DApp——与 [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]]（Hyperledger 多参与方理赔）、[[hurricaneguard]]（Etherisc 参数险）构成区块链保险三范例；理解智能合约自动审批链（医院-实验室-保险三方）与 [[insurancea2amcp]]（现代 agentic 理赔）对照。

e.summary_en: Ethereum medical-insurance claims DApp (126★, ConsenSys, active 2026-09): patient uploads bills → hospital/lab on-chain approval → insurer claim
e.summary_hk: 以太坊醫療險理賠 DApp（126★，ConsenSys，2026-09 活躍）：病人上傳賬單→醫院/實驗室鏈上審批→保險理賠
e.body_en: HealthCare-Insurance-Ethereum (Rishabh42, 126★, Solidity, updated 2026-09-03) is a medical-insurance claims decentralised application (ConsenSys project): the patient logs in, uploads medical/lab-test bills and submits them for insurance — the hospital admin verifies/approves bills on the smart contract, the lab admin approves lab-test bills, and once both approve, the insurance admin calculates the claim amount and settles it; the HealthCare.sol contract holds the logic and a web client talks to the contract. For RIAA: a runnable teaching DApp for blockchain medical claims — with [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]] (Hyperledger multi-party claims) and [[hurricaneguard]] (Etherisc parametric) it forms a blockchain-insurance trio; understand the smart-contract approval chain (hospital-lab-insurer three parties) and compare with [[insurancea2amcp]] (modern agentic claims).
e.body_hk: HealthCare-Insurance-Ethereum（Rishabh42，126★，Solidity，2026-09-03 更新）是醫療險理賠去中心化應用（ConsenSys 項目）：病人登錄上傳醫療/檢驗賬單提交理賠——醫院管理員在智能合約上驗證批准、實驗室管理員批准檢驗賬單、雙方批准後保險管理員計算並執行理賠；HealthCare.sol 合約維護邏輯，Web 客戶端與合約交互。對 RIAA：區塊鏈醫療理賠的可運行教學 DApp——與 [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]]（Hyperledger 多參與方理賠）、[[hurricaneguard]]（Etherisc 參數險）構成區塊鏈保險三範例；理解智能合約自動審批鏈（醫院-實驗室-保險三方）與 [[insurancea2amcp]]（現代 agentic 理賠）對照。
